Very good and friendly service.
Everyone speaks English.
The doc doesn’t push you for treatments you don’t need. The nurse knows how to hold that suction pipe without making you gag every 2 minutes.
Recommended

Been trying for 2 weeks to get an appointment to have the implant finished that THEY started, but they just keep ignoring any and all attempts at communication. Save yourself the trouble and take your money elsewhere.

I usually go to the dentist 3-4 times a year but my last dentist was so painful I was really scared
I spoke to the dentist here and she was so gentle . I’m now not worried any more.
Highly recommend
